annotations.title: Read custom product pages and A/B tests

description: The App Store's custom product pages (each with its state, its own link with ppid, which version is live, and its languages with promotional text) and product page optimization A/B tests (state, share of visitors, start and end, treatments with their alternate icon) of the app. Give pageId or testId for one page's or test's screenshots and previews per language (with the localization IDs ploa_marketing_upload needs). options: true lists the live version's languages and the alternate icons its build carries for tests. Apple's API gives no test results (impressions, conversion, improvement): those are only in App Store Connect › Product Page Optimization. Google Play's custom store listings and store listing experiments have no API: they are made in Play Console.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask Apple again instead of Ploa's last answer (a few minutes old at most).
